description: Open a Tango support ticket when you are blocked by Tango itself (auth, connection, a tool that errors, missing capability). Tango staff answer it; the reply lands back here via list_support_requests. Do NOT use this for client work — that belongs in create_task.

body.description: What you tried, what happened, exact error text, and what you expected.

context.description: Optional machine context: tool name, task id, raw error payload.
